description: This Java class defines the ConnectionCreated event, which is emitted after a Connection object is created. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing the Connection data.

classes.name: ConnectionCreated
classes.description: Final class representing an event emitted after a Connection is created, with methods for instantiation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ConnectionCreated event with specified Connection and headers, optionally with timestamp.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionCreated event from a JSON string or object, with specified headers.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Connection associated with this event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new event instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Builds JSON payload for the event, including the Connection data.
